gloss: to become diluted; to weaken; to fade

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {薄|うす}まっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become diluted, to become thinner, to weaken
definitions.explanation: For a liquid, color, flavor, or abstract quality to become weaker or less concentrated. Used for both physical dilution (soup becoming watery) and figurative weakening (interest fading, impressions dimming).

examples.japanese: ⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄|うす}まった。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たつ⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄|うす}まっていく。
examples.english: As time passes, memories gradually fade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{足|た}し→足す：01168_tasu⟧すぎて⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{薄|うす}まってしまった。
examples.english: I added too much water, and the color of the tea became completely washed out.

notes:
Godan verb (⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧). {薄|うす}まる → {薄|うす}まらない → {薄|うす}まって → {薄|うす}まった

USAGE:
The intransitive counterpart of ⟦{薄|うす}める→薄める：10055_usumeru⟧ (to dilute, to weaken). {薄|うす}まる describes the change happening on its own, while ⟦{薄|うす}める→薄める：10055_usumeru⟧ implies someone deliberately diluting something. Can be used for physical properties (flavor, color, concentration) and abstract qualities (memories, impressions, suspicion).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄|うす}まる: flavor becomes diluted
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄|うす}まる: memories fade
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄|うす}まる: color fades
- ⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{薄|うす}まる: impression weakens
